{
  "name": "desktop-look",
  "displayName": "Claude Code Desktop Look Mod",
  "version": "0.2.2",
  "description": "Desktop look in terminal: restyles Claude Code to resemble the Claude desktop app, with a welcome stats card, chat bubbles, bullet-free replies, compact tool rows and a Changes sidebar",
  "author": {
    "name": "Albert Zhang"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Your name",
      "description": "Shown in the welcome greeting, e.g. What's up next, Sam?",
      "default": ""
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "theme",
    "terminal",
    "tui",
    "desktop",
    "ui",
    "statusline",
    "claude"
  ],
  "homepage": "https://github.com/albertzhangz10/claude-code-desktop-look-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/albertzhangz10/claude-code-desktop-look-mod"
}
